title: P0 model-first agricultural chat
objective: Make the public TAI assistant behave as a general conversational agricultural expert instead of a narrow FAQ router, while preserving verified grounding for Transparent Price platform facts.
boundaries: No autonomous financial or platform action
General agriculture and agribusiness use the local Qwen runtime directly
Explicit safety and sensitive-input blocks remain fail-closed
acceptance: General agricultural questions reach the model without requiring a lexical knowledge-base match
Greetings and conversational follow-ups reach the model
Crop, livestock, machinery and agribusiness questions produce local-Qwen answers
Explicit platform questions remain grounded by approved public platform knowledge
Current-data questions retain the no-unverified-current-values boundary
RU, EN and ZH stream contract remains unchanged
Exact-main REG.RU live acceptance before DONE
